passive.name: Gift of Stardust
passive.text: The equipper's **Anomaly Mastery** increases by **60/69/78/87/96**. When inflicting **Assault**, the equipper's **Physical DMG** increases by **20/23/26/29/32%** for 20s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When the equipper enters combat, immediately gain 2 stacks.

passive.name: Indulge in the Hunt
passive.text: Upon activating a **Dash Attack**, gain 1 stack of **Predatory Instinct**. Each stack of **Predatory Instinct** increases the equipper's **Physical DMG** by **12/15/18/21/24%** for 10s, stacking up to 3 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When entering combat or triggering **Perfect Dodge**, gain 3 stacks of **Predatory Instinct**. While **Predatory Instinct** is at maximum stacks, the equipper's Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by **40/50/60/70/80%**.

passive.name: Data Flood
passive.text:
Increases ATK by **12/15/18/21/24%**.
When using a **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is increased by **25/31/37/43/50** for 8s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Lingering Cries
passive.text: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the equipper gains a buff that increases Anomaly Proficiency by **30/34/38/42/48**, stacking up to 4 times. This effect expires when the target recovers from Stun or is defeated. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Kiss of Death
passive.text: When there are enemies inflicted with Attribute Anomaly on the field, the equipper's ATK increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** and they deal an additional **15/17.5/20/22.5/25%** more DMG to the target.

skillPriority: Basic Attack > Chain Attack > Special Attack > Dodge > Assist

entries.name: Basic Attack: Celestial Overture
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Perform up to 5 slashes forward, dealing **Physical DMG**.
When Alice triggers **Assault** through Attribute Anomaly Buildup, the 5th hit of her next **Basic Attack** is enhanced.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz
entries.text:
When Alice's **Blade Etiquette** reaches 1 bar, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Hold to charge, expending up to 3 bars of **Blade Etiquette**. Release Basic Attack or when **Blade Etiquette** is below 1 bar, Alice performs a series of slashes in an area centered on the target enemy, with the number of hits determined by charge level, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged **Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz** hits, it triggers a special **Assault** effect: **Polarity Assault**. This deals DMG equal to 100% of the original **Assault**, ignoring Anomaly Buildup, and can interact with other Attribute Anomalies, including Physical, to trigger **Disorder**.
**Blade Etiquette** does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Jumpy Bunny
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Blade-Dancer's Gale
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Ceremony of Swordlight
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Intertwined Stab
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Parry Guard
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Cross Riposte
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Charge forward and slash enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Piercing Dawn
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Hurl the blade to strike and pass through enemies ahead, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Upon activating this skill, a **Perfect Dodge** can be triggered.
After triggering a **Perfect Dodge**, press Basic Attack to follow up with the 5th hit of a **Basic Attack**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Northern Cross
entries.text:
With enough energy, drag the joystick forward and press EX Special Attack to activate:
A thrust attack that goes through enemies ahead, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Activating the skill can trigger **Perfect Dodge** and restores 10 **Blade Etiquette**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Southern Cross
entries.text:
With enough energy, and without moving the joystick or when dragging it backwards, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Back away with a slash, then thrust forward, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Activating the skill can trigger **Perfect Dodge** and restores 10 **Blade Etiquette**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Starfall Intermission
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes powerful consecutive slashes at enemies ahead, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Starfall Finale
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Activating this skill restores 200 **Blade Etiquette**.
**Blade Etiquette** does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Twin Rainbows of the Swordheart
entries.text:
After any squad member inflicts a **Physical Anomaly** on an enemy, Alice deals additional DMG each 0.95s of its active duration, equal to 2.5% of the original Physical Anomaly DMG. If **Disorder** is triggered while the enemy is suffering a **Physical Anomaly**, for every 1s of remaining **Physical Anomaly** duration, the **Disorder** DMG multiplier increases by 18%, up to a max of 180%.
When Alice's attacks hit an enemy, she builds up **Blade Etiquette**. When she triggers an **Assault** through Anomaly Buildup, she gains 10 **Blade Etiquette**. **Blade Etiquette** has a maximum of 300, with each 100 being 1 bar.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged **Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz** lands, it triggers a special **Assault** effect: **Polarity Assault**, dealing 100% of the original **Assault** DMG, ignoring Anomaly Buildup progress. This can be combined with any Attribute Anomaly, including Physical Anomaly, to trigger **Disorder**.
When Alice triggers **Assault** on an enemy, her **Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate** increases by **25%** for 30s.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Mystery Hunt
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is an **Anomaly** or **Support** character:
When any squad member triggers **Disorder**, Alice gains 30 **Blade Etiquette**.
If Alice's Anomaly Mastery exceeds 140, each additional point grants her 1.6 Anomaly Proficiency.
Upon entering the battlefield, Alice gains 300 **Blade Etiquette**. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.

entries.name: Palmful of Cilantro
entries.text:
When Alice triggers a **Polarity Assault**, she gains 25 **Blade Etiquette**.
When she triggers **Assault** against an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 20% for 30s.

entries.name: Sage at the Sword's Tip
entries.text:
When **Ultimate: Starfall Finale**'s Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers **Polarity Assault**.
All squad members' **Assault** DMG increases by 15%. **Disorder** DMG against enemies suffering from **Physical Anomaly** increases by 15%.
Upon entering the battlefield, Alice immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. Triggers once per 180s in Investigation Zone mode.

entries.name: Symmetrism
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Rosemary on Her Lips
entries.text:
Alice ignores 10% of the target's **Physical RES**.
Enhanced **Basic Attack: Celestial Overture** accumulates 25% more **Physical Anomaly Buildup**.

entries.name: Passion for the Supernatural
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: A Heart of Thyme
entries.text: When Alice uses a third-stage charged **Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz** or **Ultimate: Starfall Finale**, she enters the **Victory State** for 30s. During this time, whenever any squad member lands a hit on a target, Alice will follow up with an extra attack against the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 3,300% of her Anomaly Proficiency. This effect can trigger once every 1s and is guaranteed to CRIT. This effect can trigger up to 6 times. Gaining the **Victory State** again refreshes the available trigger count.
